proof_summary: Introduce the auxiliary recurrence \(r_0=-2,\ r_1=-56,\ r_{n+2}=-4r_{n+1}-64r_n\). The odd-indexed terms and the squares \(r_n^2\) both satisfy \(x_{n+3}=-48x_{n+2}+3072x_{n+1}+262144x_n\); checking the first three values and inducting therefore gives their equality, hence the desired square representation.
